constraints: Adding or editing a property on the shared object must be wrapped in Use...End use, otherwise an error is generated; reading a property, however, is possible without Use...End use.

Passed values: numbers are always stored as reals; a pointer is kept as-is; dates are stored as "yyyy-mm-dd" or ISO datetime strings per the 'dates inside objects' database setting; times are stored as a number of milliseconds (Real).
